title: CKF_USER_PIN_COUNT_LOW not set after PIN failure
description:
After a failed C_Login with incorrect PIN, wolfP11 does not set CKF_USER_PIN_COUNT_LOW in C_GetTokenInfo token flags. PKCS#11 spec requires this flag to be set when the user's incorrect-PIN counter is within a threshold of the maximum lockout count.

Impact: ReadOnlySessionTest.UserLoginWrongPIN (pkcs11test) fails on the CKF_USER_PIN_COUNT_LOW assertion.

wolfP11 does not implement a PIN attempt counter or lockout. Adding this feature requires:
1. Storing a retry counter in the keystore (or adjacent metadata)
2. Incrementing on each failed C_Login call
3. Setting CKF_USER_PIN_COUNT_LOW when counter approaches limit (e.g., 1-2 attempts remaining)
4. Returning CKR_PIN_LOCKED when counter reaches max

SoftHSM2 reference: SoftHSM2 passes this test.
